verdicts.reason: A is just the original banner shrunk into a thin strip across the middle of the tall canvas, with about 70% of it left as dead white space above and below. The dark title panel covers almost all of the pattern, so the brand imagery is mostly hidden, but the headline is still readable on its dark plate. B breaks the design apart: the dark panel sits empty with no text, the pattern strip floats on its own, and the headline has moved into a thin gold outline box at the bottom on white, where it is low-contrast and cut off from its backing. The result is three disconnected fragments with no clear focal point and no longer the same design.
